title: We feel in England that we have treated you rather unfairly.
html_source:
Stephen recalls these words with bitter amusement in Chapter 9:

We feel in England. Penitent thief. Gone. I smoked his baccy.

anchor.text: We feel in England that we have treated you rather unfairly.
anchor.prefix:
1939#17

 Haines detached from his underlip some fibres of tobacco before he spoke. 

 — I can quite understand that, he said calmly. An Irishman must think like that, I daresay.
anchor.suffix:
